subject: Re: Encord x Visage - Follow Up
text:
Hi Alex,

I am writing to follow up on our recent discussions. On behalf of our team,
I want to extend a sincere thank you for your time and for the excellent
demonstrations of the Encord platform. We were all very impressed with its
capabilities and the powerful solutions you offer for data annotation.
After a thorough internal review of your platform and our current strategic
priorities, we have decided not to move forward with implementing a new
platform at this exact moment.

To provide some context, we are currently in the process of defining a more
proactive data collection strategy for the future. We believe that once
this initiative is more concrete, there will be a much stronger business
case for a comprehensive solution like Encord. At that stage, we would be
in a better position to seek the necessary investment from our board,
highlighting the clear value your system provides.

With that in mind, we would very much like to stay in touch. We will be
keeping Encord in mind as our strategy evolves, and we will certainly reach
out when the timing is right on our end.

Thank you once again for your support and understanding.

Best regards,
Mateja
